decisions: Minutes of the September 7, 2025 board meeting approved as presented.
Revised Q4 2025 budget approved with a 6% reduction in discretionary spending; Pierre Dubois to circulate updated budget model to all department heads by October 12, 2025.
Lena Strauss appointed as Lead Engagement Manager for the Northwind Partners account, effective November 1, 2025.
Aiyana Park and Pierre Dubois to finalize and submit the expanded service proposal to Northwind Partners by October 20, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to schedule quarterly executive review calls with Northwind Partners leadership beginning Q1 2026.
Phase 1 of the technology infrastructure upgrade approved with a budget cap of $175,000 for Q4 2025; Phase 2 deferred to Q1 2026.
Mid-year performance bonus program and $2,500 annual professional development allowance per employee approved, effective January 1, 2026; implementation framework due December 1, 2025.
Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park to attend the Global Advisory Summit, November 12–14, 2025, in Chicago.
Next board meeting scheduled for November 2, 2025.
